result.summary: The page is largely well-designed with consistent spacing, typography, and a clear visual hierarchy. One minor visual inconsistency was found in the horizontal restaurant carousel.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the first card (Green Bowl Poké) uses a light gray image background while the adjacent cards (Smash Bros Burgers, Trattoria Piccola) use dark backgrounds. This creates an inconsistent visual rhythm across the row.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent image background treatment (e.g., a uniform dark or neutral backdrop) across all carousel cards so the row reads as a cohesive set.
